execution.trigger: run function called with input larger than count
execution.state_issue: count is a uint256 type, subtracting more than its value causes underflow
execution.exploitable_behavior: count decreases below zero or wraps to large positive number

causality.state: initialized == 0 and count has been decremented beyond its minimum value
causality.guard: no checks for input size before subtraction
causality.transition: arithmetic operation proceeds without bounds checking
causality.capability: attacker can provide large inputs to cause underflow
